mapper.sql: WITH org00 AS ( SELECT org01_code_id AS org00_org_code_id , org01_org_cd AS org00_org_cd , org02_kor_nm AS org00_kor_nm , org02_mod_date AS org00_mod_date FROM org01_code INNER JOIN org02_info ON org02_code_id = org01_code_id WHERE org01_company_id = #{companyId} )
mapper.select: SELECT emp03_person_id AS person_id , emp01_emp_no AS emp_no , org00_kor_nm AS org_name , emp01_kor_nm AS emp_kor_name , emp01_lock_yn AS lock_yn FROM emp03_trans trans INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN org00 ON emp03_org_code_id = org00_org_code_id LEFT OUTER JOIN emp25_mypage_notice ON emp03_person_id = emp25_person_id WHERE 1=1 AND emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp03_trans_cd NOT IN ('900') AND emp03_trans_date IN ( SELECT max(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date <= #{transDate}::date ) AND org00_mod_date = ( SELECT max(org00_mod_date) FROM org00 WHERE org00_org_code_id = emp03_org_code_id AND org00_mod_date <= emp03_trans_date ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp04_add_title WHERE emp04_add_person_id = emp01_person_id AND ( emp04_start_date > #{transDate}::date OR COALESCE(emp04_close_date,'9999-12-31') < #{transDate}::date ) ) ORDER BY org00_org_cd, emp03_title_cd, emp01_emp_no, emp01_order_seq

SELECT emp03_person_id AS person_id , emp01_emp_no AS emp_no , org00_kor_nm AS org_name , emp01_kor_nm AS emp_kor_name , emp01_lock_yn AS lock_yn FROM emp03_trans trans INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = emp03_person_id INNER JOIN org00 ON org00_org_code_id = emp03_org_code_id WHERE 1=1 AND emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp01_person_id = #{personId} AND emp03_trans_cd NOT IN ('800','900') AND emp03_trans_date IN ( SELECT max(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND to_char(emp03_trans_date,'yyyymmdd') <= replace(#{transDate}::varchar,'-','') ) AND org00_mod_date = ( SELECT max(org00_mod_date) FROM org00 WHERE org00_org_code_id = emp03_org_code_id AND org00_mod_date <= emp03_trans_date ) ORDER BY org00_org_cd, emp03_title_cd, emp01_order_seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys25_password (sys25_password_id, sys25_company_id, sys25_person_id, sys25_seq, sys25_pwd, sys25_work_date) SELECT f_create_seq() , #{companyId} , #{personId} , ( SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sys25_seq),0) + 1 FROM sys25_password WHERE sys25_person_id = #{personId} ) , TO_ENCRYPTS(#{pwd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) , f_sysdate()
